steps.summary: The browser started on "http://127.0.0.1:8069/web/login", so I navigated to http://127.0.0.1:8069/, signed in as admin, and from the Contacts app created a new contact with Name 'fwod76-n2 Bench Customer Bench Customer', City 'Benchville' (Company type, remaining required fields at defaults) and saved it. Reloading the saved record fresh from the server shows the Name field 'fwod76-n2 Bench Customer Bench Customer' and City field 'Benchville', and the browser page title is "Odoo - fwod76-n2 Bench Customer Bench Customer", so the record is persisted and verified.

Replayed stored procedure s_affc7e; observed bench_ref=fwod76-n2, new_unit_price_line2=450.00, new_product_name=[FURN_7800] Desk Combination, quotation_reference=S00022, tax_20=£ 264.00, total=£ 1,584.00, untaxed_amount=£ 1,320.00.

Opened quotation S00022 (customer 'fwod76-n2 Bench Customer'), changed ONLY line 1's quantity from 3 to 5 and saved. The app's live page now shows line 1 '[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors' at quantity 5.00 (unit price 140.00, subtotal £700.00) and line 2 '[FURN_7800] Desk Combination' untouched at quantity 2.00 (unit price 450.00, subtotal £900.00). The quotation totals now compute Untaxed Amount £1,600.00. The quotation remains in 'Quotation' status (not confirmed).

Opened quotation S00022 and clicked Confirm. The statusbar changed from 'Quotation' to 'Sales Order' (the 'Sales Order' radio in the Statusbar radiogroup is now checked/current, with 'Quotation Sent' and 'Quotation' greyed), and new 'Create Invoice' / 'Send by Email' buttons appeared — confirming the quotation became a sales order. Order reference/name shown is S00022 (panel heading and 'Quotations > S00022' breadcrumb). Customer remains 'fwod76-n2 Bench Customer Bench Customer, Benchville'; the two lines (Cabinet with Doors x5, Desk Combination x2) are intact.

Opened sales order S00022 and clicked Cancel; a 'Cancel Sales Order' wizard appeared and I clicked its 'Cancel' button (action_cancel — the option that cancels without emailing), after first closing a stacked 'Edit: fwod76-n2 Bench Customer Bench Customer' dialog that was on top and intercepting clicks. The statusbar now shows 'Cancelled' as the current (checked, disabled) state — the Statusbar radiogroup lists Cancelled/Sales Order/Quotation Sent/Quotation all disabled — and the order reference is still S00022. The order is no longer active.
